items.q: How do I book a training?
items.a: Find a training you like, open its detail page and click "Book". You need to be logged in to book.

items.q: Can I cancel or change a booking?
items.a: Yes. Go to "My bookings" to cancel a booking. To change one, cancel the current booking and book the training you want again.

items.q: How do I pay for a training?
items.a: The price is shown on each training. Payment is arranged with the trainer according to the stated terms.

items.q: What happens if a training is full?
items.a: A full training can no longer be booked — you'll see a "Full" label. Keep an eye on the page, as a spot may open up after a cancellation.

items.q: Do I get a confirmation after booking?
items.a: Yes, after a successful booking you'll see a confirmation right away and the training appears under "My bookings".

about.title: About Classo
about.subtitle: The easiest way to find and book sports classes near you.
about.intro: Classo connects people who want to move with the trainers and coaches who make it happen. From boxing and yoga to footvolley on the beach, you discover classes in your neighbourhood and book a spot in just a few clicks.
about.mission: Our mission is to make sport accessible and social. We give independent trainers a simple platform to fill their classes, and give participants a clear overview of what's happening around them.
